prompt: Stylised 3D mobile game with a hand-painted gouache look and soft brush textures, festival night on a narrow river through an old canal town: a small folded paper-lantern boat carrying one glowing candle flame drifts down dark glassy water, weaving between mossy rocks and gliding between two glowing lantern posts; as it passes close to a little riverside shrine hung with paper lanterns its flame flares brighter and warm light spills across the water. No text, no people.
